description: Wait for a session to be ready, or for: "rebuild" after an edit; only after wait:false, a ready.status not "ready", or noBrowser; answers port, controlPort and cdpPort or rdpPort. A page condition is extension_eval until; never sleep in a shell.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

for.description: rebuild: the next compile and reload after an edit.

since.description: rebuild: ISO time a compile must follow.

timeoutMs.description: Wait budget in ms, default 45000, clamped 1000-50000.

name: extension_wait
